name: zcliprect_trivial_reject_poly_xy
description: zClipRect::TrivialRejectPolyXY rejects a polygon when all vertices fall outside any enabled XY clip edge and otherwise accepts it.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this zClipRect helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClipRect source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja evidence for 0x4803b0 shows leaf loops over g_Clip_PolyVerts for each enabled clip flag: x < xMin, x >= xMax, y < yMin, and y >= yMax all-outside tests return 0; otherwise the function returns 1.
The native smoke verifies accepted in-bounds geometry, rejection by each XY edge, and the flags-zero path.
